conditions.B_bias_replacement: Known last-MLP output matrix and output bias replaced with public base. Apply identical operation to unprotected control.
conditions.ProDistill: Same author elementwise kernel,64 unlabeled training images per task and task identity;100 epochs each12 blocks. Teachers frozen, only attacker coefficients optimized. No AGA preprocessing.

"""Existing recovery procedures on the three frozen projection controls."""
import gc
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from _impl.attacks import public_mlp_replace
from _impl.io import digest
from _impl.merge import parameter_hash
from _impl.models import apply, checked_models

root = Path('outputs/projection_recovery_20261103')
source = Path('outputs/finite_projection_ablation_20261103')
read = lambda p: json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def save(p, value):
    Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2)+'\n')
def run(log, *args):
    with open(log, 'w') as stream:
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-u', *map(str,args)], stdout=stream,
                       stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
protocol = read('results/data_free_compensation/projection_recovery_protocol.json')
for path, sha in protocol['source_sha256'].items():
    assert digest(path)==sha, path
for task, sha in protocol['frozen_points'].items():
    assert digest(source/task/'point/point.pt')==sha
run(root/'prodistill.log','-m','experiment.distill','--prodistill',
    '--protocol','results/data_free_compensation/projection_prodistill_protocol.json')

for task, sha in protocol['frozen_points'].items():
    peer = 'SVHN' if task=='MNIST' else 'MNIST'
    case=task+'_'+peer
    p=root/task
    p.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    release=dict(path=str(source/task/'point/point.pt'),sha256=sha)
    main=read(source/task/'evaluation.json')
    main['source_sha256']={path:digest(path) for path in main['source_sha256']}
    run(p/'matching.log','-m','experiment.recover','--target',task,'--method','mlp-match',
        '--publication',release['path'],'--sha256',sha,'--output',p/'MLP_matching')
    match=read(p/'MLP_matching/execution.json')
    direct_scores=source/task/'evaluation/full'/('00_'+case)/'artifacts/predictions.pt'
    refs=protocol['references'][task]
    for method in ['matching','replacement']:
        cfg=json.loads(json.dumps(main)); name='ProjectionControl_'+method+'_'+task
        pub=dict(path=str(p/'MLP_matching/edits.pt'),sha256=match['output_sha256']) if method=='matching' else release
        current=dict(target=task,partner=peer,defenses=[name])
        if method=='replacement':current['public_replacement']=dict(layer=11,side='B+b')
        cfg.update(output=str(p/method),experiment='Frozen projection control; '+method,
            attack_scopes=['None'],defenses={name:dict(target=task,release=pub)},cases=[current])
        scores=dict(path=str(direct_scores),sha256=digest(direct_scores)) if method=='matching' else {k:refs['replacement'][k] for k in ['path','sha256']}
        cfg['legacy']={case+'/Unprotected':{stage:dict(**scores,key_template='Unprotected/'+key+'/{task}')
            for stage,key in [('standalone','Standalone/None'),('direct','TA/None')]}}
        if method=='replacement':
            for stage,key in [('standalone','Standalone/None'),('direct','TA/None')]:
                cfg['legacy'][case+'/Unprotected'][stage]['model_parameter_sha256']=refs['replacement']['parameters']['Unprotected/'+key]
        save(p/(method+'.json'),cfg)
        for stage in ['pilot','full']:
            run(p/(method+'_'+stage+'.log'),'-m','experiment.main_table','--protocol',p/(method+'.json'),
                *(['--pilot'] if stage=='pilot' else []))
            run(p/(method+'_'+stage+'_verify.log'),'-m','experiment.main_table',
                '--verify',p/method/stage/('00_'+case))
    # The complete known block replacement is unchanged for any edit inside it.
    base, expert, head, pins=checked_models(task)
    own=apply(expert,release)
    clean=public_mlp_replace(expert.state_dict(),base.state_dict(),11,'MLP')
    replaced=public_mlp_replace(own.state_dict(),base.state_dict(),11,'MLP')
    assert clean.keys()==replaced.keys() and all(torch.equal(clean[k],replaced[k]) for k in clean)
    save(p/'complete_block_equality.json',dict(tensors=len(clean),all_equal=True,
        parameter_sha256=parameter_hash(clean),new_image_forwards=0,
        scope='Known whole last MLP replacement; not original AGA or unknown-location recovery'))
    save(p/'completed.json',dict(status='matching_and_B_bias_replacement_completed',point_sha256=sha))
    del base,expert,head,own,clean,replaced
    gc.collect()
save(root/'completed.json',dict(status='three_frozen_projection_controls_recovery_completed',
                              new_defense_updates=0,new_AGA_calls=0))
